title: CCBR/RENEE_NF pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow implementation of bulk RNAseq pipeline RENEE https://ccbr.github.io/RENEE/latest/

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

genome.description: Reference genome (e.g. hg38, mm10). This can be a genome in conf/genomes.config, or see 'Custom genome options' to build a custom reference from a fasta & gtf file.

star_index.description: Path to STAR genome index directory. If unset, the pipeline attempts params.genomes[genome].star_index.

star_gtf.description: Path to GTF annotation for STAR. If unset, the pipeline attempts params.genomes[genome].genes_gtf.

star_pass1_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to nf-core STAR_ALIGN in pass 1.

star_pass2_args.description: Additional command-line arguments appended to STAR in pass 2.

star_2_pass_basic.description: Run STAR in per-sample two-pass basic mode (--twopassMode Basic) instead of the default multi-sample two-pass alignment.

picard_strand_specificity.description: Strand specificity passed to Picard CollectRnaSeqMetrics.

publish_dir_mode.description: How to publish files to the results directory. This parameter sets Nextflow's workflow.output.mode configuration option.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Options for supplying or building a custom reference genome.

genome_fasta.description: Path to reference genome FASTA file. Required when building a custom reference with --genes_gtf.

genes_gtf.description: Path to gene annotation GTF file. Required when building a custom reference with --genome_fasta.

rename_contigs.description: Path to a two-column tab-delimited file mapping old contig names (column 1) to new contig names (column 2). Applied to both the FASTA and GTF when building a custom genome.

organism.description: Short organism identifier written into the genome config (e.g. homo_sapiens, mus_musculus). Defaults to 'custom' when not provided.

annotate.description: Path to annotate.genes.txt for a custom genome. Used when supplying a custom genome via --genome_fasta/--genes_gtf.

annotate_isoforms.description: Path to annotate.isoforms.txt for a custom genome. Used when supplying a custom genome via --genome_fasta/--genes_gtf.

refflat.description: Path to refFlat.txt for a custom genome. Used when supplying a custom genome via --genome_fasta/--genes_gtf.

bed_ref.description: Path to genes.ref.bed for RSeQC when using a custom genome.

qualimap_info.description: Path to qualimap_info.txt for a custom genome.

karyobeds.description: Path to the karyobeds directory for a custom genome.

karyoploter.description: Path to karyoplot gene coordinates for a custom genome.

rsem_ref.description: Path prefix to a pre-built RSEM reference (e.g. /path/to/rsemref/hg38_30). Used when supplying a custom genome via --genome_fasta/--genes_gtf.

rrna_list.description: Path to an rRNA interval list for a custom genome.

tin_ref.description: Path to transcripts.protein_coding_only.bed12 for RSeQC TIN when using a custom genome.

fusion_blacklist.description: Path to an Arriba fusion blacklist file for a custom genome.

fusion_cytoband.description: Path to an Arriba cytobands file for a custom genome.

fusion_protdomain.description: Path to an Arriba protein domains GFF3 file for a custom genome.

fusion_known_fusions.description: Path to an Arriba known fusions file for a custom genome.

index_dir.description: Root directory containing pre-built genome indices. Used by HPC profiles (biowulf, frce) to locate references when --genome is set.

build.description: When true, the pipeline stops after building the custom genome reference without proceeding to alignment.

build_shared_resources_only.description: When true, download and publish only the shared FastQ Screen and Kraken2 databases without preparing a genome or analyzing samples.

shared_resources.description: Shared FastQ Screen and Kraken2 database directory. With --build or --build_shared_resources_only, downloaded databases are published beneath this directory.

kraken2_db_dir.description: Path to an existing Kraken2 database directory. Takes precedence over shared_resources for Kraken2 classification.

database_urls.description: Map of database names to archive URLs consumed by the DOWNLOAD_DATABASES subworkflow.

qc_options.title: QC options
qc_options.description: Options for FastQ Screen contamination screening.

fastq_screen_conf.description: Path to the primary FastQ Screen configuration file. Set automatically by HPC profiles (biowulf, frce). FastQ Screen is skipped when not provided.

fastq_screen_conf2.description: Path to the secondary FastQ Screen configuration file (second screening panel). Set automatically by HPC profiles (biowulf, frce).

fastq_screen_db_dir.description: Path to the FastQ Screen database directory. Set automatically by HPC profiles (biowulf, frce).

alignment_options.title: Alignment options
alignment_options.description: Options controlling the two-pass STAR alignment workflow.

sjdb_placeholder_tab.description: Path to an empty splice-junction placeholder file passed to STAR_ALIGN pass 1 in place of a real SJDB file.

max_job_request_options.title: Max job request options
max_job_request_options.description: Set the top limit for requested compute resources. These values cap the per-process resource labels defined in conf/base.config.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job (e.g. '224 GB').

max_time.description: Maximum wall-time that can be requested for any single job (e.g. '72 h').
